design_core.dependence: iid innovation base + uniform indicator finite-memory L1 approximation <= C_dep*rho^d
design_core.local_law: uniform marginal approximation <= C_ls*n^(-zeta), uniform second-time-derivative bound L2
projections: location/scale interval ratio with zero-scale fail-close
design_core.candidate_domain: 18 nominal anchors j/20,j=2..19; ceil(j*n/20); all-later; latest-state required

fixed_method_assumption.statement: There exists an iid innovation sequence supporting the finite-memory indicator representation.

forbidden_inference: DEV outcome used to select assumption constants

structural_assumptions.statement: There exists an iid innovation sequence supporting the finite-memory indicator representation used by the frozen method.

model_use_input_schema.acceptance_rule: G-A2 PASS requires A_R5_01_IID_INNOVATION_BASE=ACCEPTED_FOR_MODEL_USE and every numeric/bound input accepted for one identical declared process scope, with scope consistency and outcome independence PASS.
model_use_input_schema.conflict_rule: Any structural assumption rejection/unresolved state, missing numeric/bound input, scope mismatch, or outcome-dependent binding blocks G-A2.

alpha_stat.meaning: family-wide statistical error budget for the final simultaneous CDF event

statistical_governance_schema.rule: Statistical uncertainty and operational movement tolerance remain separate ledgers.

structural_eligibility: candidate N is an effective CandidateDomain V2 mapped anchor
N<n and at least one later state exists
required model-use inputs, numerical profile, and alpha_stat are bound

method_outputs.local_cdf_band: simultaneous [L*,U*] over required chronology/horizon/full-CDF threshold domain
method_outputs.common_N: MINIMUM_SUPPORTED_APPROVED_GRID_ANCHOR after final method + policy criteria

G_A0_METHOD_FREEZE.required: this final contract frozen with valid child hashes

G_A1_INDEPENDENT_THEOREM_REVIEW.required: latest compatible theorem-review result for this frozen design/child hashes is PASS with GA1-F01 resolved

G_A2_MODEL_USE.required: A_R5_01_IID_INNOVATION_BASE and all numeric/bound model-use inputs are ACCEPTED_FOR_MODEL_USE for one identical declared scope

G_A3_NUMERICAL_PROFILE.required: beta and mu prospectively approved; structural eligibility rules executable

G_A4_STATISTICAL_GOVERNANCE.required: alpha_stat approved for this exact target/method identity

G_B.required: tau_T,tau_L,tau_S and approval authority/policy contract approved

D3_IMPLEMENTATION.required: G_A PASS and implementation authorization explicitly issued

REFERENCE_ADEQUACY_EVALUATION.required: G_A PASS, G_B PASS, implementation/numerical checks complete

failure_codes.MODEL_PARAMETER_BINDING_MISSING: required model-use parameter absent or unapproved
failure_codes.MODEL_USE_SCOPE_MISMATCH: approved assumption scope differs across required inputs or evaluation scope
failure_codes.INSUFFICIENT_LOCAL_WINDOW_DOMAIN: backward local window cannot fit at earliest required chronology state
failure_codes.EMPTY_PROJECTED_CDF_BAND: coverage-preserving projection crosses on realized inputs
failure_codes.ANCHOR_SCALE_ZERO_NOT_EXCLUDED: anchor MAD outer interval includes zero
failure_codes.OUTSIDE_R5_APPROVED_CANDIDATE_GRID: candidate not in frozen CandidateDomain V2
failure_codes.STRUCTURALLY_INELIGIBLE_NO_LATER_STATE: mapped anchor has no later state
failure_codes.METHOD_HASH_MISMATCH: bound child or final semantic/design hash differs from frozen identity
failure_codes.MODEL_STRUCTURAL_ASSUMPTION_UNBOUND: required structural model-use assumption is absent or unresolved
failure_codes.MODEL_STRUCTURAL_ASSUMPTION_REJECTED: required structural model-use assumption was rejected for the declared process scope

new_contract_version_required_for: gate semantics change that alters evaluation eligibility
actual-process assumption ownership change that changes G-A2 eligibility

semantic_hash_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON with recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, compact separators, and semantic_contract_sha256 plus semantic_hash_rule omitted

ga1_br1_resolution.resolution: A_R5_01_IID_INNOVATION_BASE is explicitly both a theorem assumption and a mandatory actual-process model-use acceptance item.
